#### Spatially normalize trajectories

Raw -> splined -> resampled

```{r}
# also reshape because model wants that
dt <- dt[
  ,
  .(hand_x = spline(seq_along(hand_x), hand_x, 1000)$y),
  by = .(trajectory, participant, target_loc, distractor_loc, hand_used, side_used)
] |>
  _[,
    .(hand_x = hand_x[seq(1, 1000, length.out = 100)]),
    by = .(trajectory, participant, target_loc, distractor_loc, hand_used, side_used)
  ]
```

```{r}
require(dplyr)
require(tidyfun)
tt <- dt[,
  .(hand_x = list(hand_x)),
  by = .(trajectory, participant, target_loc, distractor_loc, hand_used, side_used)
]

tt[, hand_x := tfd(hand_x)]

palette <- c("#fbb4ae", "#b3cde3", "#fed9a6")

tt[tt$hand_used == "left"]$hand_x <- tt[tt$hand_used == "left"]$hand_x * -1

tt |>
  # filter(hand_used == "right") |>
  # mutate(hand_x[hand_used == "left"])
  # group_by(target_loc, distractor_loc, side_used) |>
  # summarize(hand_x = mean(hand_x)) |>
  # summarize(hand_x = mean(hand_x)) |>
  tf_ggplot(aes(tf = hand_x, colour = side_used)) +
  # geom_smooth() +
  geom_fboxplot() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-200, 200)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = palette) +
  facet_grid(distractor_loc ~ target_loc)

tt |>
  group_by(target_loc, distractor_loc, side_used) |>
  summarize(
    mean_x = mean(tfb(hand_x, verbose = FALSE)), # pointwise mean function
    sd_x = sd(tfb(hand_x, verbose = FALSE)), # pointwise sd function
    .groups = "drop_last"
  ) |>
  group_by(target_loc, distractor_loc, side_used) |>
  mutate(
    upper_x = mean_x + 2 * sd_x,
    lower_x = mean_x - 2 * sd_x
  ) |>
  tf_ggplot() +
  geom_line(aes(tf = mean_x, color = side_used)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(tf_ymin = lower_x, tf_ymax = upper_x, fill = side_used), alpha = 0.3) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-50, 50)) +
  facet_grid(target_loc ~ distractor_loc)
```


Recoding
---

#### Predictors

Objects' literal positions were procedurally relevant, but tangential to inference.

Instead, dummy factors will be coded representing:

- Distractor side (Palmar, Dorsal)
  - Describes, at trial start,  which side of the hand the distractor fell.
  - Note: independent from whether Ss responded with palm or Dorsal
- Distractor adjacent (T, F)
  - Describes whether distractor was positioned adjacent to trial target
- Effector side (Palmar, Dorsal)
  - This is already present within the data

The other benefit is that now everything is dichotomous.

```{r}
dt$target_loc <- as.character(dt$target_loc)
dt$distractor_loc <- as.character(dt$distractor_loc)
dt$hand_used <- as.character(dt$hand_used)

dt[, which_hand := factor(
  fifelse(
    hand_used == handedness,
    "Dominant", "Non-Dominant"
  )
)]

# dummy coding distractor locations
dt[
  ,
  distractor_pos := factor(
    fcase(
      (target_loc == "centre") & (distractor_loc != hand_used), "Palmar",
      (distractor_loc == "centre") & (target_loc == hand_used), "Palmar",
      (target_loc == hand_used), "Palmar",
      default = "Dorsal"
    ),
    levels = c("Dorsal", "Palmar")
  )
]

dt[
  ,
  effector_side := factor(
    fifelse(side_used == "back", "Dorsal", "Palmar"),
    levels = c("Dorsal", "Palmar")
  )
]

# dt[
#   ,
#   distractor_effector := factor(
#     fifelse(distractor_side == effector_side, "Same", "Opposite"),
#     levels = c("Opposite", "Same")
#   )
# ]

dt[
  ,
  hand_used := factor(
    hand_used,
    levels = c("right", "left"),
    labels = c("Right Hand", "Left Hand")
  )
]
```

Final cleanings & normalizations
---

#### Crop trajectories by distance travelled

As we're only interest in curvature during approach, equalizing trajectories by cropping them at the 30 cm mark (along the z-axis).
This value is only sorta arbitrary, 30 cm is the median (z) distance at which x_position reaches it's max.

```{r}
dt <- dt[hand_z <= 30]
```

#### Spatially normalize trajectories

```{r}
num_points <- 1000

# Function to resample a single reach
resample_reach <- function(x_obs, num_points) {
  # Create a sequence representing the current indices of the reach
  original_index <- seq_along(x_obs)

  # Create a sequence for the new indices
  new_index <- seq(
    from = min(original_index),
    to = max(original_index),
    length.out = num_points
  )

  # Use spline interpolation to get the new values
  spline(original_index, x_obs, xout = new_index)$y
}

model_data <- dt[
  ,
  .(
    pos_x = resample_reach(hand_x, num_points),
    pos_y = resample_reach(hand_y, num_points),
    pos_z = resample_reach(hand_z, num_points)
  ),
  by = .(
    participant, block_num, trial_num, target_loc,
    hand_used, which_hand, distractor_pos, effector_side
  )
] |>
  _[,
    index := seq_len(.N),
    keyby = .(
      participant, block_num, trial_num, target_loc,
      hand_used, which_hand, distractor_pos, effector_side
    )
  ]
```

Remove participants still listed as possible factor levels

```{r}
model_data <- droplevels(model_data)
```

```{r}
save(model_data, file = here::here("data", "proc", "04_out.rdata"))
```
